info.title: HTML/CSS to Image app Universal API
info.description: Generate images, screenshots, PDFs, and reusable templates from HTML and CSS using the HTML/CSS to Image API.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

html.description: HTML markup to render into an image.

css.description: CSS styles to apply to the HTML or inject into the target URL page.

url.description: Public URL to screenshot instead of rendering HTML directly.

googleFonts.description: Google Fonts to load before rendering.

deviceScale.description: Pixel ratio for rendering, from 0.1 to 3.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to capture.

fullScreen.description: Capture the full scrollable page height.

blockConsentBanners.description: Block consent and cookie banners before capture.

colorScheme.description: Render using light or dark mode.

timezone.description: IANA timezone to use while rendering.

disableTwemoji.description: Use native emoji fonts instead of Twemoji.

url.description: Permanent URL for the generated image.
